46365.subject: Woodwork
46365.question_text:
State three differences between hardwood and softwood based on their:
(i) Botanical origin
(ii) Growth rate
(iii) Common uses in woodworking.
46365.explanation:
Marking Scheme:
(i) Botanical origin: Hardwoods come from dicotyledonous (broad-leaved) trees, while softwoods come from gymnosperms (coniferous trees). (2 marks)
(ii) Growth rate: Hardwoods generally grow slower than softwoods, resulting in denser wood. (2 marks)
(iii) Common uses: Hardwoods are often used for furniture, flooring, and high-quality joinery, while softwoods are commonly used for construction, framing, and general carpentry. (2 marks)

46366.subject: Woodwork
46366.question_text: Name two Ghanaian hardwoods and two Ghanaian softwoods, stating one specific use for each.
46366.explanation:
Marking Scheme:
Hardwoods:
(i) Mahogany – Used for high-quality furniture and cabinetry. (1 mark)
(ii) Wawa – Used for plywood and interior joinery. (1 mark)
Softwoods:
(i) Cedrela – Used for construction and roofing. (1 mark)
(ii) Pine – Used for framing and general carpentry. (1 mark)

46367.subject: Woodwork
46367.question_text: Explain the difference between air seasoning and kiln seasoning, stating one advantage and one disadvantage of each method.
46367.explanation:
Marking Scheme:
Air Seasoning:
- Process: Timber is stacked outdoors and allowed to dry naturally. (1 mark)
- Advantage: Low cost and environmentally friendly. (1 mark)
- Disadvantage: Slow process and dependent on weather conditions. (1 mark)
Kiln Seasoning:
- Process: Timber is dried in a controlled environment using heat and humidity. (1 mark)
- Advantage: Faster and more precise moisture control. (1 mark)
- Disadvantage: High energy consumption and initial setup cost. (1 mark)

46368.subject: Woodwork
46368.question_text: Which of the following timber conversion methods is most suitable for producing quarter-sawn boards?
46368.explanation: The quarter-sawing method involves cutting the log radially to produce boards with straight grain patterns, reducing warping and enhancing stability. This method is ideal for high-quality furniture and flooring.

46369.subject: Woodwork
46369.question_text: Describe three common timber defects and suggest one method to prevent each.
46369.explanation:
Marking Scheme:
(i) Warping: Distortion of timber due to uneven drying. Prevention: Proper stacking and controlled seasoning. (2 marks)
(ii) Checks: Cracks along the grain caused by rapid drying. Prevention: Gradual seasoning and sealing ends. (2 marks)
(iii) Knots: Weak points where branches were attached. Prevention: Selecting knot-free timber or using fillers. (2 marks)

46370.subject: Woodwork
46370.question_text: Which manufactured board is most suitable for kitchen cabinet construction due to its moisture resistance?
46370.explanation: Marine plywood is treated to resist moisture, making it ideal for environments like kitchens where humidity and water exposure are common.

46371.subject: Woodwork
46371.question_text: Explain two methods of maintaining a hand plane to ensure its efficiency.
46371.explanation:
Marking Scheme:
(i) Sharpening the blade: Regularly hone the blade using a whetstone to maintain a sharp edge. (2 marks)
(ii) Cleaning and lubrication: Remove dust and debris, then apply oil to prevent rust and ensure smooth operation. (2 marks)

46372.subject: Woodwork
46372.question_text: Sketch and label two types of wood joints used in frame construction, stating one advantage of each.
46372.explanation:
Marking Scheme:
(i) Mortise and Tenon Joint: Strong and durable, ideal for load-bearing frames. (2 marks for sketch + 1 mark for advantage)
(ii) Dovetail Joint: High resistance to pulling forces, commonly used in drawer construction. (2 marks for sketch + 1 mark for advantage)

46373.subject: Woodwork
46373.question_text: Which of the following Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) is essential when operating a circular saw?
46373.explanation: Safety goggles protect the eyes from flying debris, which is critical when using high-speed cutting tools like a circular saw.

46374.subject: Woodwork
46374.question_text: Describe the process of applying a varnish finish to a wooden surface, highlighting three key steps.
46374.explanation:
Marking Scheme:
(i) Surface Preparation: Sand the wood smoothly and remove dust. (2 marks)
(ii) Application: Use a brush to apply a thin, even coat of varnish, following the grain. (2 marks)
(iii) Drying and Sanding: Allow the varnish to dry, then lightly sand between coats for a smooth finish. (2 marks)
